title: Week 7 Cheat Sheet: GNN Design & Training

items.label: Modules
items.note: Batch norm: zero mean, unit variance (stabilises). Dropout: zero neurons w.p. $p$ in training, all neurons at test. ReLU most common; sigmoid only to restrict range.

items.label: Over-smoothing
items.note: Many layers ⇒ large overlapping receptive fields ⇒ similar embeddings. $K$ layers = $K$-hop field.

items.label: Layer connectivity
items.note: More expressive layers; pre/post MLP layers; skip connections: $N$ skips → $2^N$ paths.

items.label: Graph manipulation
items.note: No features → constants/one-hot IDs. Sparse → virtual edges/node (distance ≤ 2). Dense → neighbour sampling. Large → subgraph sampling.

items.label: Prediction heads
items.note: Node: $W_{head}h_v$. Edge: Linear(Concat) or $h_v^\top h_u$. Graph: mean/max/sum pooling.

items.label: Losses
items.note: Cross-entropy for classification, MSE (L2) for regression.

items.label: Splits
items.note: Transductive: one graph, split labels. Inductive: break edges, multiple graphs; graph classification is inductive only.

items.label: Link prediction
items.note: Self-supervised. Message edges feed the GNN; supervision edges are targets and are not fed in.
